text: My app keeps crashing every time I open it on iOS 17
Sorry about that! Please delete the app, restart your phone, and reinstall from the App Store -- that clears the cache causing crashes. ^Demo
I was charged twice this month for my subscription, $12.99 twice
That looks like a duplicate charge. Check your receipts at ourapp.com/account -- if you see two charges on the same date we'll refund the extra one within 3-5 business days. ^Demo
How do I cancel my premium plan before renewal?
You can cancel anytime from Settings > Plan > Cancel Subscription. You'll keep access until the end of your current billing period. ^Demo
I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives
Try checking your spam folder first. If it's not there, go to ourapp.com/reset and make sure you're using the email on your account. ^Demo
Where is the dark mode setting? I can't find it
It's under Settings > Appearance > Dark Mode. Toggle it on and it applies instantly. ^Demo
Someone logged into my account from another country and changed my email
This needs immediate attention -- please go to ourapp.com/secure-account to lock your account, our safety team will follow up directly. ^Demo
My order says delivered but I never received the package
Sorry to hear that! Carriers sometimes mark packages delivered early. If it hasn't shown up in 24 hours, go to Your Orders > Problem with Order for a replacement. ^Demo
App crashes immediately on launch after the latest update
Thanks for flagging -- try a clean reinstall (delete app, restart device, reinstall). That resolves this for most people after an update. ^Demo
The checkout page freezes when I try to pay with a new card
Sorry about that! Try switching to a different browser or clearing your cache -- the checkout freeze usually clears up right after. ^Demo
Can I share my playlist with a friend who doesn't have an account?
Yes! Use the Share button and send the link -- they can listen to a preview without signing up, full access needs a free account. ^Demo
